title: J.P. Morgan Adds Two Tokenized Money Market Funds to Solana
why_it_matters: The expansion gives institutional investors and stablecoin issuers another public-blockchain route into J.P. Morgan-managed cash products, extending the funds beyond a single network without opening them to retail trading.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONS

J.P. Morgan Adds Two Tokenized Money Market Funds to Solana

J.P. Morgan Asset Management has made MONY and JLTXX available on Solana to qualified U.S. investors through its Morgan Money platform.
